project: Weave Self-Iteration Browser Export Contract Tightening
description: Small Ralph self-iteration for branch ralph/self-iteration-20260519-170927. The previous active PRD belonged to ralph/self-iteration-20260519-160430 and all stories were passing, so it was archived under scripts/ralph/archive/self-iteration-20260519-171304/. No PR CI auto-fix context was present in progress.txt. Kickoff health: latest GitHub main CI run 26087345493 completed green on commit 4eeb507, while Codespaces prebuild 26087344906 was still in progress. Local sampled checks for known fresh-CI risks passed via `go test ./cmd/server -run 'TestBuildEmbeddingProvider|TestEmbeddedWebDist|TestSPA|TestCI' -count=1` and `npm --prefix web test -- --run src/components/admin/__tests__/ComplianceReportsPage.test.tsx`. Current dogfood findings DOG-003, DOG-004, and DOG-005 already have dedicated regression coverage in the tree, so this PRD focuses on current Browser export and Time Travel trust gaps found during inspection.

userStories.name: Refuse silently capped Browser exports
userStories.description: Prevent operators from downloading a Browser export that was silently truncated by the 100000-row client hard cap.
bdd_acceptance: Given a Browser export response advertises a total row count greater than the 100000-row export cap, When the operator exports CSV, JSON, or XLSX, Then the export fails with a clear limit error before any partial file is downloaded.

Given a paginated Browser export reaches the 100000-row cap and the server still returns a nextPageToken, When the export loop evaluates the page, Then it fails with the same clear limit error instead of returning partial rows.
Given an export is within the cap, When the operator exports rows, Then the existing CSV, JSON, and XLSX download behavior remains unchanged.

userStories.name: Block Browser export affordance during Time Travel
userStories.description: Align the Browser page with its historical-mode contract by disabling the export menu while a Time Travel checkpoint is active.
bdd_acceptance: Given Time Travel has pinned an asOf value for the active ontology, When the Browser header renders, Then the Export button is disabled and explains that exports are unavailable in historical mode.
Given Time Travel is inactive, When the Browser header renders, Then the Export menu remains available with CSV, JSON, and XLSX options.
Given Time Travel is turned off after being active, When the Browser header re-renders, Then the export affordance is restored without losing the current Browser query state.
